releaseNotes:
Notes v1.8.23 (Build 195):
• Display Name Only: Username editing removed; your display name shows on the Both of Us card on both phones
• Real Couple Hug: Original 🫂 blues, him taller and broader, her head on his shoulder, in a smaller hug
• Couple Emojis: Man & woman pairings kept, boy & girl pairings removed, 🫂 at the top right of the tray
• Steady Emoji Size: Emojis in the message box stay the size they are sent at
• Voice Note Progress: See where a voice note is up to while it plays
• Profile Photo Breathes Even When Offline
• Softer Grey Timestamps
• Fixed: Get Every Call When Closed setup button
